author: BCRG Account Owner (Codex)
method_assessment: The frozen development example authenticates its inputs, pairs simulation draws, and passes the neutral-response control. Its positive mean promised-reward saving supports the declared point-sign prediction within four paired 30-day comparisons. Packaged expected results were available, so this exercises reproduction rather than blinded confirmation. The reward-response coefficients are assumed, and the counter observation precedes the origin cutoff by 193 seconds. No observed post-origin outcome, predictive-validity score or causal estimate is part of this result.
direction_assessment: The next experiment should test sensitivity to reward-response assumptions before interpreting this example as policy evidence. A consequential comparison also needs a declared uncertainty target and a paired-run budget sufficient to assess it. The present four-pair sign check supplies neither a confidence interval nor robustness across response settings.
continuation_question: Does the reward-saving sign persist under separately declared response assumptions, and how precisely can the paired effect on reward promises and validator stake be estimated?

proposals.action: Specify a new development experiment comparing zero, weaker and stronger reward responses while retaining paired seeds and input identities.
proposals.expected_benefit: Separate the direct formula effect from consequences of assumed participation responses.
proposals.success_check: Freeze the response settings and measures before execution, then report reward saving and stake retention separately for every setting.

proposals.action: Set a precision criterion and choose a paired-run budget before using simulation differences for a consequential recommendation.
proposals.expected_benefit: Measure simulation uncertainty instead of treating a positive sample mean as robust evidence.
proposals.success_check: Report a paired interval and whether the predeclared precision criterion was reached, with model and response uncertainty kept separate.
